in_telugu.long_meaning: Tīḷa (til) + ka (ka) - tilaka (mark, symbol, or sign made by applying a powder or paste on the forehead)

in_marathi.name: Tilak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tilak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A mark or sign, especially one made by applying a powder or vermilion to the forehead of a Hindu as a symbol of devotion or blessing.

vedic_reference.note: The name Tilak is derived from the Sanskrit word tilaka, which means 'mark, symbol, or sign made by applying a powder or paste on the forehead.' In Hindu mythology, tilaka is applied as a symbol of protection and blessing from the gods.
